newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Alpargatas Santista begun.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Alpargatas Santista begun.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it initiated coverage of Brazil's Alpargatas Santista Textil with a buy recommendation.
-- It said the company is beginning to show the positive effects of its recent restructuring program. The company's 1996 net income was 15.1 million reais, against a loss of 57 million reais in 1995.
-- Fator said the company's earnings could rise in 1997 to 22 million reais.
-- Alpargatas Santista Textil is Latin America's largest producer of denim and twill and Brazil's biggest textiles exporter, it added.
-- Alpargatas Santista Textil preferred rose 4.17 percent to 125 reais in late afternoon trade on the Sao Paulo bourse.
